questions.q: What is the capital of Cambodia?
questions.why: It lies where the Mekong meets the Tonlé Sap river.

questions.q: Which huge temple complex is on Cambodia's flag?
questions.why: It is the largest religious monument in the world.

questions.q: Which empire built Angkor?
questions.why: It was at its peak from the 800s to the 1400s.

questions.q: Which regime ruled Cambodia from 1975 to 1979?
questions.why: Its rule killed about two million people.

questions.q: Who led the Khmer Rouge?
questions.why: He died in 1998.

questions.q: From which country did Cambodia gain independence in 1953?
questions.why: King Norodom Sihanouk led the campaign.

questions.q: What is Cambodia's currency?
questions.why: US dollars are also widely used.

questions.q: Which king led Cambodia to independence?
questions.why: He ruled, resigned and returned several times.

questions.q: Which king built Angkor Wat in the 1100s?
questions.why: It was dedicated to Vishnu.

questions.q: Which former Khmer Rouge school became a prison museum?
questions.why: About 20,000 people were held there.

questions.q: Which country invaded in 1979 and ended Khmer Rouge rule?
questions.why: It occupied Cambodia for ten years.

questions.q: Who was Prime Minister of Cambodia from 1985 to 2023?
questions.why: His son Hun Manet succeeded him.

questions.q: Which 1984 film told the story of the Khmer Rouge years?
questions.why: Haing S. Ngor won an Oscar for it.

questions.q: Which king built the Bayon temple with its stone faces?
questions.why: He made Buddhism the state religion.

questions.q: Who has been King of Cambodia since 2004?
questions.why: He was a ballet teacher in Paris.

questions.q: Which great lake swells hugely in the rainy season?
questions.why: Its river reverses direction each year.

questions.q: Which river flows through Cambodia?
questions.why: It flows from Tibet to Vietnam.

questions.q: Which jungle temple has trees growing over its walls?
questions.why: It appeared in 'Tomb Raider'.

questions.q: Which town is the gateway to Angkor?
questions.why: Its name means 'Siam defeated'.

questions.q: Which steamed fish curry is the national dish?
questions.why: It is cooked in banana leaves.

questions.q: What language is spoken in Cambodia?
questions.why: It has the world's longest alphabet.

questions.q: Which classical dance shows celestial dancers?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which pink sandstone temple is famous for fine carvings?
questions.why: Its name means 'citadel of women'.

questions.q: Which hilltop temple caused a border dispute with Thailand?
questions.why: The world court gave it to Cambodia in 1962.

questions.q: Which seaside town is famous for pepper?
questions.why: Kampot pepper has protected status.

questions.q: Which water festival marks the Tonlé Sap river reversing?
questions.why: It includes boat races in Phnom Penh.

questions.q: What is the Khmer New Year called?
questions.why: It is held in April.

questions.q: Which bamboo train ran near Battambang?
questions.why: It runs on old rails.

questions.q: Which 1960s rock singer is called Cambodia's 'King of Golden Voice'?
questions.why: He died under the Khmer Rouge.

questions.q: Which riverside complex is the King's home in Phnom Penh?
questions.why: Its Silver Pagoda has a silver floor.
